title: Measure continuation correctness across twelve recovery situations
body: Operator selected measurements of existing KRN mechanisms, not adoption based on research alone. Source: .krn/runs/rss-research/reports/Mechaniki zwiększające skuteczność KRN.md. All proposed effects remain unmeasured in KRN. No external service, production, credential or global policy mutation is granted by this task. Pre-register the bounded pilot and independent oracle before running it.

Outcome: evaluate whether a fresh agent continues the right work after restart/compaction, beyond capsule validity or memory retrieval.
Acceptance:
- Define all twelve cases before execution. The report gives categories, not a complete twelve-case matrix: changed HEAD, closed task, missing file, parallel outcomes, interrupted write, Unicode and truncated context. Add cases explicitly, do not pretend the report enumerated them.
- Reference answers include goal, owner, constraints, exact authority, unproven acceptance conditions and next step. Expected answers must not be leaked in the final probe prompt.
- Compare actual fresh-agent continuation against an independent prepared oracle and current receiver/repository state. Unknown/unverifiable authority must stay unknown; stale HEAD or closed tasks must not inherit old acceptance.
- Pilot gate: zero invented grants and zero false acceptances, with every critical field correct. Record per-case failures, tokens and time to correct action. Twelve successes are a pilot result, not proof of universal reliability.
- Reuse native callback/semantic proof from t-b6v615x and the existing state fixtures. Do not replace the current hook implementation with a new framework or weaken observers to fit an answer.

Operator research extension: pre-register a cheap model-free interruption between canonical JSON replacement and Markdown projection replacement. Exercise a state.md-only reader BEFORE load() projection repair, not just repaired load(). Check goal/owner/authority/next and reject false currentness or invented grants. Source proposal: .krn/runs/rss-research/reports/Dowody i odporność mechanik KRN.md; identity, current authority, result correctness and evidence completeness are separate observations.
